{{CharInfobox |color={{white color}} |corecolor={{red color light}} |bordercolor={{red color}} |name=Pinery |jname=マツバラ |tmname=Matsubara |image=Pinery.png |caption=Pinery |size=250px |hometown=[[Vermilion City]] |region=[[Kanto]] |trainer=yes |game=no |gender=Female |colors=yes |hair=Blue |eyes=Blue |anime=yes |epnum=JN049 |epname=To Train, or Not to Train! |enva=[[Alyson Leigh Rosenfeld]] |java=真堂圭 [[Kei Shindō]] }} '''Pinery''' (Japanese: '''マツバラ''' ''Matsubara'') is recurring character who first appeared in ''[[JN049|To Train, or Not to Train!]]''. She is the head of the [[Eevee Evolution Lab]]. ==History== [[File:Pinery Chloe.png|250px|left|thumb|Pinery giving Eevee to Chloe]] Pinery was first seen collecting an {{TP|Chloe|Eevee}} that had attempted to imitate a {{p|Vaporeon}} by swimming, only for her to fail. Along with her assistants, she tried to get the Eevee to [[Evolution|evolve]] using a [[Fire Stone]] and a [[Thunder Stone]]. However, neither [[Evolution stone]] succeeded in this regard, leaving them confused as to why Eevee wouldn't evolve. Pinery later traveled to the [[Cerise Laboratory]], where she and her assistants collected Eevee after she had left the Eevee Evolution Laboratory. As they were leaving, Eevee decided she wanted to stay with [[Chloe]] after befriending her. Upon seeing this, she allowed Chloe to keep Eevee and informed her that she was somehow unable to evolve. She reappeared in a flashback in ''[[JN063|On Land, In the Sea, and to the Future!]]''.
